action: I search the collapsed shrine for the missing tide-ledger.

setting.name: Saltmarsh Shrine
setting.desc: A collapsed nave half-swallowed by the marsh.

taboo.name: Naming the drowned
taboo.desc: The dead of the marsh are never spoken of by name.

myth.name: The Tide that Remembers
myth.desc: They say the marsh keeps a ledger of every debt owed it.

pc.name: Brunn Graniteback
pc.headline: a dwarf cleric chasing a stolen reliquary

fronts.danger: The marsh rises a hand each night

dmOnly.truth: the ledger is a lock holding the tide back
dmOnly.doom: the shrine floods and the ledger is lost for good

recentLedger.text: Brother Vael admitted the ledger was taken on the night of the spring tide.

gazetteer.name: Brother Vael
gazetteer.desc: the shrine's last warden, half-drowned in guilt
